Why we exist

They are not
long-term earners.

Athletes finish with elite discipline, motivation and drive. What they lack is a bridge. The knowledge, context and guidance to translate what they already have into the career they want next.

Ramon Not "athletes need help." Athletes need a structured path, and nobody built one. That is the gap this program fills.

one path.

[ 02 ]
Foundations

[ 03 ]

[ 04 ]

Advisory comes first on purpose. A skills assessment sets the technical path before a single class starts, which is what lifts completion.

Ramon Five pillars in order. Direction before curriculum. Placement is not a bolt-on, it is pillar five.

The structure

Built for people
with a schedule.

The shape of it

6-9 mo
Part-time, start to placement.
2x week
Live classes, three hours per session.
Flipped
Facilitators over lecturers. Peer milestones, hands-on coding labs.
Selected
Pre-program interview. Proven motivation to build a durable post-sports career.

Beyond the technical

Workplace fundamentals
Slack · Zoom · AI fundamentals
Professional communication
And financial literacy
Mental health support
Elite athlete to tech innovator
The identity shift is the hardest part of the transition. It is programmed for, not left to chance.
Ramon Athletes know cohorts and reps. This is training camp structure applied to tech. The wraparound column is what keeps people in the room.

Fund the

Three ways in

[ 01 ]
Sponsor a cohort. Underwrite a full cohort from advisory through certification.
[ 02 ]
Open the door. Placement partnership, including sports-adjacent roles.
[ 03 ]
Bring your people in. Technical leaders teaching live, mentorship, advisory.

Credentials
CompTIA certifications earned by name, cohort by cohort.
Reporting
Enrollment, completion and placement, reported not estimated.
Pipeline
First look at athletes finishing the technical track.
Access
The athletes, their networks, and the story that comes with both.
Placement partnership is the fastest yes for a league or a team. Lead with it in those rooms.
